#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll modpow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k, l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;
    vector<ll> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    int m = 2 * n;
    vector<vector<ll>> rows(m + 1, vector<ll>(m + 2, 0));
    rows[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
            ll val = 0;
            if (j > 0) val = (val + rows[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
            val = (val + rows[i - 1][j + 1] * (j + 1) % MOD) % MOD;
            rows[i][j] = val;
        }
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = k; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = k; j <= n; ++j) {
            ans = (ans + rows[i][j] * rows[m - i][j] % MOD * fac[j] % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    ll denom = rows[m][0];
    ll inv_denom = modpow(denom, MOD - 2);
    ll inv_2n1 = modpow(m + 1, MOD - 2);
    ll result = l * ans % MOD * inv_denom % MOD * inv_2n1 % MOD;
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
